text:
The canvas holds:
pay-someone-new — Entry screen for the MVP's core solution (seq 7: payee-creation API callable from the app channel) scoped to a single UK sort-code/account-number payee (seq 12's in-bounds case). Includes a hidden modal-dialog for the close-match decision customers must resolve unaided (seq 6, seq 23) before continuing.

Propose the next screen.

input.why: Follows pay-someone-new once Confirmation of Payee has run: shows the match result and the first-payment limit (seq 23's stated refusal — no skipping the check, a cap on day one), and carries the scam-intervention decision as a hidden modal-dialog (seq 8, seq 17: the screen must do the job the agent's ear used to do) whose shown text and the customer's response are exactly what the audit trail and security boundary require (seq 14, seq 30).

text: Screen **confirm-and-send** has been proposed: it reports the Confirmation of Payee result, states the first-payment limit inline (seq 23), and carries the scam-intervention question as a hidden `modal-dialog` — the one decision surface this journey needs, whose exact wording and the customer's response are what the audit trail (seq 14) and the security boundary's "what we refuse to store beyond the response" (seq 30) depend on. "Send payment" remains the screen's single committing action.
